resolved_owners.resolution: Display owns one fixed 2048-slot native pool, cache GBIX, active/requested Memory borrows, selected list and eight scratch words. texture_state()/texture_selection_state() borrow these exact fields; no copy or second native pool. Pool is never resized by inspected operations. Pointer stability depends on retaining that fixed extent. Native/ref worlds are separate instances, not duplicate owners of one live world.

Session owns regular/menu/character/font List objects and forwards release to Display. List entries borrow Memory slots; release retains entry pointers even after slot reset. MovieScene owns its own List and calls the low list release via Display. LogoRenderer borrows Display pool/state and owns its logo list plus non-owning resident-slot associations. List filename shared_ptrs are real imported metadata absence; first_filename_invalid is an explicit source filename sentinel observation, not an executable address identity.

Memory owns Surface/source backing and physical allocation; Draw owns immutable graphics::Texture separately. LogoRenderer observes Surface weakly and holds current device image strongly; snapshot_bound_texture observes a replacement before a draw. Release drops manager image/backing without revoking submitted images. No GPU resource address is used as native identity.

resolved_consumers.resolution: LogoRenderer loads actual imported PVM/PVR records, searches/acquires from borrowed pool, skips decode on cached acquisitions, selects through shared texture-selection algorithm, releases logo list, and unbinds for colored polygon submission.
Display performs scene release, scratch clear, guarded and movie list release, and owned ARGB movie acquisition; MovieScene updates the same Memory surface after decoded movie uploads.
Session release wrapper and TitleScene font/menu release callbacks reach Display rather than a separate texture manager.

NativeTextures reads Memory/Entry palette fields and stores revision before unsupported palette upload; uses shared detail algorithm. It borrows current/requested/cache/active owners, does not own another pool.

Concrete List consumers beyond direct manager calls: regular_textures mutates imported entries/attributes and temporarily swaps localized filenames, restoring only after successful loader return; menu release clears loaded bit before live language/catalog lookup and release callback. game_cleanup tests first entry binding,not live Surface,for character unload. font forwards borrowed List through load/release callbacks. texture_list_gate checks all bindings plus explicit invalid-filename sentinel. These algorithms remain outside assigned modules and are not certified by this review.
